georgia.title: Flag of Georgia

colors.note: Field representing innocence, chastity, purity, and wisdom
The central cross and four smaller crosses representing Christianity and the five holy wounds

desc:
- White field with a large red St George's cross dividing it into four quarters, each bearing a smaller red Bolnisi-Katskhi cross
- Adopted on 14 January 2004, replacing the 1990 red-and-black flag after the Rose Revolution
trivia:
- Known as the Five Cross Flag, the design is based on medieval banners dating back to the 14th-century Kingdom of Georgia
- The four smaller Bolnisi-Katskhi crosses refer to the five wounds of Christ, linking the flag directly to the Georgian Orthodox Church
- The flag was championed by the United National Movement opposition before being formally adopted after the 2003 Rose Revolution
